I hope you can help me with an issue regarding my Cheetah3D 8.x license.

My configuration is:

MacBook Pro 15" Retina Mid 2014
Intel Iris Pro + NVIDIA GeForce GT 750M
16 GB RAM
macOS Ventura 13.7.8
OpenCore Legacy Patcher
In Cheetah3D 8.x, strange triangles/polygons appear in the shaded viewport. They disappear in Wireframe mode and are also not present in the final render.

I tested both GPUs separately:

Intel Iris Pro → same artifacts
NVIDIA GeForce GT 750M → same artifacts
I also experience a similar issue in SketchUp with its newer graphics engine. Switching SketchUp to the Classic Graphics Engine completely resolves the problem.

Most importantly, I previously tested Cheetah3D 7.x on the same Mac, and the viewport works perfectly without these artifacts.

Because Cheetah3D 8 uses the newer Metal-based viewport, I suspect this may be a compatibility issue with the legacy GPU/Metal environment on my Mac.

I have already emailed Martin regarding this, but unfortunately I haven't received a response yet.

Would it be possible to provide me with the Cheetah3D 7.5.3 installer and convert my existing Cheetah3D 8.x license to a Cheetah3D 7.x license?

I would really prefer to continue using Cheetah3D rather than request a refund. Cheetah3D 7.x works very well on my Mac and is sufficient for my workflow.

I would really appreciate any help from Martin or anyone who can point me in the right direction.

Thank you!
